evals.prompt: Use $still-scenes-postcard-zine with my attached flower photo. Make a landscape split postcard. Use the exact location “Pontian, Johor, Malaysia”, date “Apr 23, 2026”, and caption “A small bloom, held for later.”
assertions: Routes to Postcard Create with the split surface.
Treats the photo as an edit target with high preservation.
Records all supplied strings as locked copy.
Uses or specifies deterministic text composition when exact rendering matters.
Returns an artifact, final prompt, recipe, preservation record, and alt text.

evals.prompt: Use $still-scenes-postcard-zine to generate the picture too. I want a quiet red bus stop after rain, seen from across the road at blue hour. Make a postcard front with the exact caption “The rain left first.”
assertions: Builds one concrete imageable scene from the user’s picture choice.
Does not substitute an unrelated visual metaphor.
Locks the caption exactly.
Uses an image-led front recipe.

evals.prompt: Use $still-scenes-postcard-zine with this seaside photo. Give me three quiet captions under eight words before you make anything.
assertions: Returns three materially different caption options.
Does not generate the postcard before the user selects a caption.
Avoids slogans, hashtags, and unsupported emotional claims.

evals.prompt: Turn this portrait into a postcard. Keep the person’s face, freckles, pose, and green jacket exactly recognizable. You may change only the background and paper treatment.
assertions: Classifies the photo as an edit target with high preservation.
Records face, freckles, pose, and jacket as invariants.
Permits only the background and paper changes.
Retries or reports a limitation if identity drifts.

evals.prompt: Make one postcard from these three unrelated photos.
assertions: Inspects all usable images.
Asks one concise question about which picture to use.
Does not silently select based on hidden metadata.

evals.prompt: Make a duplex card from this mountain image. Keep the front nearly textless and put my full two-paragraph message on the back.
assertions: Returns separate front and back artifacts.
Keeps dimensions and orientation aligned.
Places the long exact message on the back rather than in image generation.
Does not fabricate an address or official postage.

evals.prompt: Distill this night-window photo into a zine artwork. Do not keep the photo. Express the feeling of one lit room answering another.
assertions: Routes to Scene Zine Create.
Uses the photo as low-preservation semantic input.
Creates a new visual relation and composition.
Does not copy source text, date, location, or exact layout.

evals.prompt: Give me only the final image-generation prompt for a writable postcard back in warm ivory with an orange camera mark. Do not generate an image.
assertions: Routes to Prompt-only.
Returns a resolved prompt and recipe.
Does not generate an artifact or imply that it did.

evals.prompt: Analyze this one postcard reference and give me reusable rules without making a new image.
assertions: Separates observed traits from interpretation.
Reports single-sample confidence limits.
Separates fixed candidates, variables, and sample residue.
Does not copy source wording or exact composition.

evals.prompt: Create four cards from these four trip photos. Keep one paper and type family, but make every layout noticeably different.
assertions: Maps each image to one card.
Plans at least three layout families.
Changes at least three meaningful axes between adjacent cards.
Returns a variation ledger.

evals.prompt: Make a postcard from this photo. Do not add a location.
assertions: Does not inspect or expose EXIF GPS for copy.
Leaves the location field blank.
Does not invent a place from visual clues.

evals.prompt: The exact caption must be “I’ll remember the yellow door.” Make sure every character is correct.
assertions: Treats the sentence as locked copy.
Verifies apostrophe, spelling, casing, and punctuation.
Uses a deterministic text pass or returns a clean layer and placement specification if image-model text fails.
Does not claim exactness without inspection.
